rationale: Both score the game the same way and return the same errors. They differ in how they track game state. A recomputes the frame and roll position on every Roll and Score by replaying the whole roll history in a state() function full of nested conditionals. Its tenth-frame validation then indexes back into g.rolls at hard-to-follow offsets, which makes the logic hard to check. B keeps incremental state in clearly named, commented fields (frame, pinsFrame, frameRolls, tenthPins, tenthMax, over). It handles frames 1-9 and the tenth frame in two separate, readable blocks, and resetting the standing-pin count after a strike or spare in the tenth frame expresses the fill-ball rules directly. B also moves scoring into a pure helper with commented cases. B is easier to read and to verify.
